western.natal: The sky at the moment of birth: the planets' sign and house positions, the angles and the aspects between planets.
western.transit: Aspects the planets at the selected moment make to the natal chart: strength, orb, applying/separating, the natal house the transiting planet is passing through and a bi-wheel chart. It is a snapshot of a single moment; exact moments are shown from the calendar when opened from a Transit Calendar day.
western.forecast: Over a period, the exact moments of transit aspects to the natal chart together with sign ingresses, stations, eclipses and Moon phases; provider significance score. Selecting a day opens that day's details; the day's transit chart is calculated separately on request. The provider request is split into parts of at most 90 days.
western.progression: Secondary progression: each day after birth corresponds to one year of life; the progressed chart for the target date.
western.solar_arc: All natal points are advanced by the arc travelled by the progressed Sun.
western.solar_return: Chart of the moment the Sun returns to its natal longitude; used for the theme of the selected year.
western.lunar_return: Chart of the moment the Moon returns to its natal longitude. A calendar month may contain two returns; each return is a separate request.
western.synastry: Aspects between two people's charts and how one person's planets fall into the other's houses.
western.composite: A single relationship chart built from the midpoints of two charts.
western.astrocartography: The places where the planets were on the MC, IC, Ascendant and Descendant at the birth moment, drawn as lines on a world map.
western.relocation: The same birth moment calculated for another location: planetary positions do not change; the Ascendant, MC and houses do.
western.local_space: The planets' horizon directions (azimuth) as seen from the selected centre; on a compass and a map.
western.fixed_stars: Tropical positions of 43 fixed stars at the birth moment and their ecliptic longitude conjunctions with the natal planets, Ascendant and MC. This is not the paran method. The orb setting is only a filter; changing it does not require a new calculation.
western.profections: One sign is advanced from the Ascendant sign for each completed year of age (whole sign houses): the active house, sign and classical ruling planet of the selected profection year, and the ruler's sign and house in the birth chart.
western.extra_points: Extra points for the natal chart in three optional sections: four asteroids (Ceres, Pallas, Juno, Vesta), seven Hermetic lots (with the day/night formula) and the mean and true (osculating) positions of Black Moon Lilith. Each section is calculated separately; if a saved natal with the same house system exists, they are shown as a layer on the natal wheel.
western.planetary_return: Chart of the moment the selected planet (Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury) returns to its natal longitude. In a retrograde cycle the planet may cross its natal degree 2–3 times; the crossings in the cluster closest to the target date are listed and the selected crossing is calculated.
western.transit_scan: Transit scan: aspects of the transiting planets to natal points (the seven classical planets, Ascendant, MC) over the selected date range (at most 1 year); for each aspect the orb entry, exact moment(s) (1/2, 2/2 … in a retrograde cycle), orb exit and type; also stations and sign ingresses. A single orb applies to all aspects (default 1°). Natal points come from the natal result; the scan runs in the Yaşam Sistemi local engine.
western.classical_dignities: Classical dignities and almuten: essential (domicile, exaltation, triplicity, term, face) and accidental dignity scores of the seven classical planets, planetary receptions, house almutens, the chart almuten (Greeks CA p. 532 standard; other sets as alternatives) and the Lord of the Geniture (interpretation). Default school William Lilly (1647); Dorothean can be selected. Positions come from the natal result; the calculation runs in the Yaşam Sistemi local engine.
western.declination_parallels: Declination contacts between two bodies in the selected month: parallel (same declination) and contraparallel (opposite declination), the exact moment, both declinations and the orb; chronological list. A measure separate from ecliptic aspects; it is a sky calendar and birth data is not used.

vedic.d1: Sidereal Rashi kundli: Lagna, the grahas' sign and bhava placements, nakshatra / pada and yogas.
vedic.varga: Divisional charts: each sign is divided into n parts (D9 Navamsa by default); vargottama is marked.
vedic.dasha: Vimshottari: 120-year planetary periods from the Moon's nakshatra at birth; sub-periods (down to Prana level) load on click in the result screen; optional current period chain.
vedic.drishti: Parashari whole-sign graha drishti: which graha aspects which sign and bhava. Calculated with Lahiri only.
vedic.ashtakavarga: Bindu scores given by each graha and the Lagna to the 12 signs, the Sarva total and Shodhana.
vedic.shadbala: Six-component strength of the grahas (BPHS); ratio to required strength and ranking.
vedic.panchanga: The tithi, nakshatra, nitya yoga and karana of the birth moment; optional detailed day (vara, sunrise/sunset, Rahu Kaal, Abhijit…) and planetary hours (hora) + Choghadiya. Calculated with Lahiri only.
vedic.transit: Gochara: houses of the sidereal grahas at the selected moment from the Janma Rashi and from the Lagna, drishti and kaksha. Lahiri only.
vedic.bhav_chalit: Bhava (Sripati) houses: the start, madhya (cusp) and end (sandhi) of each bhava; the grahas' chalit bhava compared with the whole-sign (rashi) house of the Vedic D1. A house method separate from D1.
vedic.chara_karaka: Jaimini chara karakas: the grahas are ranked by their degree within the sign (Atmakaraka … Darakaraka). The 8-karaka scheme includes Rahu (reversed degree); the 7-karaka scheme does not.
vedic.arudha: Jaimini arudha padas: Arudha Lagna (AL), A2…A11 and Upapada (UL) — bhava lord, the lord's rashi, the count and the 1st/7th house exception, with the sign and house placement from the Lagna.
vedic.bhava_bala: Strength of the twelve houses (bhavas): Bhavadhipati Bala (Shadbala total of the house lord), Dig Bala and Drishti Bala; total virupa / rupa and ranking. Planetary strength (Shadbala) is a separate technique.
vedic.gun_milan: Ashtakoot Gun Milan: eight koota scores (Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakoot, Nadi) from both people's Moon nakshatra and sign, a total out of 36, Nadi / Bhakoot dosha and the classical cancellation rules; Manglik status for both people. A technical assessment; it gives no relationship verdict.
vedic.monthly: Sidereal (Lahiri) sky calendar of the selected month: planetary sign ingresses (with the direction of motion at the crossing), exact astronomical aspects of 22 types between planets and with the Moon, declination parallel / contraparallel events; optional birth-moment declinations. Chronological timeline, planet filter, UTC and local time, monthly summary. Astronomical aspects are not traditional graha drishti.
vedic.sade_sati: Saturn's passage through the 12th, 1st and 2nd houses from the Janma Rashi (natal Moon sign): Sade Sati status and phase (rising / peak / setting) on the assessment day.
vedic.dashakoot: South Indian Ten Porutham (Dashakoot): each of the Dina, Gana, Mahendra, Stree Deergha, Yoni, Rasi, Rasyadhipati, Vasya, Rajju and Vedha criteria met / not met; a total out of 10 and the strict Rajju / Vedha constraints. A system separate from Gun Milan; a technical assessment.
vedic.papasamyam: Papasamyam: malefic contributions of Mars, Saturn, the Sun and Rahu in the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th houses counted from the Lagna, Moon and Venus in both charts, weighted totals and a comparison of the two totals. A technical assessment.
vedic.upagraha: Upagrahas: calculated sensitive points (not celestial bodies). The time-based ones (Gulika, Mandi, Kala, Mrityu, Ardhaprahara, Yamaghantaka) derive from the 8-fold division of day / night, the Sun-derived ones (Dhuma, Vyatipata, Parivesha, Indra Chapa, Upaketu) from the Sun's longitude; sign, degree, nakshatra and pada.
vedic.heliacal: Graha Asta / Udaya: whether the six visible grahas are free of the Sun's glare (Surya Siddhanta kalamsa) on the selected day and observation place, and the last and next heliacal rising / setting dates. A place-dependent calculation, different from the “combust” mark in the birth chart.

kp.chart: KP chart with Placidus cusps: sign, star, sub and sub-sub lord for each point; four-level significators.
kp.dasha: Vimshottari periods with the KP ayanamsa and the KP significators of the period lords.
kp.ruling: Ruling planets at the selected moment and place with their natal significators.
kp.transit: Two modes: Single moment — the KP sky at the selected moment (star and sub lords); Time range — Sub-Lord (KP number) change moments of the selected planets, Rasi changes and an optional KP position table. The provider does not offer transit analysis against the natal cusps.
kp.horary: Question chart from a number between 1 and 249; birth data is not used. The question moment and the assessment place are selected.
kp.ruling_interval: Ruling planets step by step over the selected time range, the sign / star / sub / sub-sub lords of the Lagna and Moon and their change moments. Significators come from each moment's sky chart (a different method from the natal significators of the KP ruling planets technique); birth data is not used.
